CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_automation_operational_report()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_report jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.crm_require_staff();
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
   'last_evaluated_at', m.last_evaluated_at,
   'evaluated',m.examined,'scheduled',m.scheduled,'blocked',m.blocked,
   'finished',m.finished,'review_required',m.review_required,
   'pending', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.crm_follow_ups WHERE status='pending'),
   'overdue',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.crm_follow_ups
              WHERE status='pending' AND due_at<=now()),
   'consented_customers',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.crm_customers
                           WHERE consent_status='granted' AND NOT commercial_opt_out),
   'provider_timestamps',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.crm_tintim_message_events
                             WHERE direction='inbound' AND time_basis='provider_timestamp'),
   'official_webhook_events',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.crm_whatsapp_message_events),
   'delivery_enabled',false,
   'channel','provider_not_certified',
   'source','read_only_automation_monitor'
 ) INTO v_report
 FROM public.crm_automation_monitor m WHERE singleton=true;
 RETURN coalesce(v_report,'{}'::jsonb);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_automation_queue_items()
 RETURNS TABLE(follow_up_id uuid, conversation_id uuid, queue_state text, blockers text[], evaluated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.crm_require_staff();
 RETURN QUERY SELECT q.follow_up_id,q.conversation_id,q.queue_state,
  q.blockers,q.evaluated_at FROM public.crm_automation_queue q
 JOIN public.crm_follow_ups f ON f.id=q.follow_up_id
 WHERE f.status='pending'
 ORDER BY q.due_at ASC LIMIT 150;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_cancel_customer_followups_on_conversion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status='converted' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'converted' THEN
    UPDATE public.crm_follow_ups SET status='canceled',resolved_at=now(),
      resolution_reason='customer_converted'
    WHERE status='pending' AND conversation_id IN
      (SELECT id FROM public.crm_conversations WHERE customer_id=NEW.customer_id);
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_delivery_prepare_holds()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 v_processed integer:=0;
 v_held integer:=0;
 v_canceled integer:=0;
BEGIN
 IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' AND
    (session_user <> 'postgres' OR auth.role() IS NOT NULL) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'crm_internal_only' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(72180310,20261028) THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('skipped','already_running','sent',0);
 END IF;
 WITH tracked AS (
   SELECT f.id follow_up_id,f.conversation_id,f.due_at,
          f.status follow_up_status,
          coalesce(q.blockers,ARRAY[]::text[]) reason_codes
     FROM public.crm_follow_ups f
     LEFT JOIN public.crm_automation_queue q ON q.follow_up_id=f.id
    WHERE f.created_at > now()-interval '30 days'
    ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT 500
 ), staged AS (
   INSERT INTO public.crm_delivery_outbox AS o
     (follow_up_id,conversation_id,due_at,state,blocker_codes,last_audited_at)
   SELECT t.follow_up_id,t.conversation_id,t.due_at,
          CASE WHEN t.follow_up_status='pending'
                    THEN 'held' ELSE 'canceled' END,
          -- Source of truth is the observed queue; do not manufacture
          -- an eligible send state even after explicit consent is captured.
          CASE WHEN t.follow_up_status='pending'
            THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT code FROM unnest(
              t.reason_codes || ARRAY['provider_not_certified']::text[] ||
              CASE WHEN t.due_at>now() THEN ARRAY['not_due']::text[]
                   ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END
            ) code ORDER BY code)
            ELSE ARRAY['followup_not_pending']::text[] END,
          now()
      FROM tracked t
   ON CONFLICT (follow_up_id) DO UPDATE SET
     conversation_id=excluded.conversation_id,
     due_at=excluded.due_at,
     state=excluded.state,
     blocker_codes=excluded.blocker_codes,
     last_audited_at=excluded.last_audited_at
   RETURNING state
 )
 SELECT count(*)::integer,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='held')::integer,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='canceled')::integer
   INTO v_processed,v_held,v_canceled
   FROM staged;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('observed',v_processed,'held',v_held,
   'canceled',v_canceled,'sent',0,'delivery_mode','disabled');
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_delivery_readiness()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.crm_require_staff();
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'mode','disabled',
  'provider','unconfigured',
  'holds', count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='held'),
  'canceled',count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='canceled'),
  'sent',0,
  'last_audited_at',max(last_audited_at),
  'blockers', jsonb_build_array(
    'provider_access_unconfirmed','official_sender_not_configured',
    'opt_in_and_provider_timestamp_required'),
  'next_step','verify_whatsapp_business_account_and_phone_number_id'
 ) INTO v_result FROM public.crm_delivery_outbox;
 RETURN v_result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_delivery_receipt_summary()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_summary jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.crm_require_staff();
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
   'prepared',count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='prepared'),
   'accepted',count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='accepted'),
   'sent',count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='sent'),
   'delivered',count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='delivered'),
   'read',count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='read'),
   'failed',count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='failed'),
   'unknown_outcome',count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='unknown_outcome'),
   'mode','provider_not_enabled'
 ) INTO v_summary FROM public.crm_delivery_attempts;
 RETURN v_summary;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_hold_tintim_purchase_signals()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_canceled integer:=0;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.crm_require_staff();
  WITH flagged AS (
    SELECT f.id,f.conversation_id
    FROM public.crm_follow_ups f
    JOIN public.crm_conversations c ON c.id=f.conversation_id
    JOIN public.tintim_conversations t ON t.id=c.tintim_conversation_id
    WHERE f.status='pending' AND
      lower(btrim(coalesce(t.stage_label,''))) IN
        ('comprou','convertido','venda realizada','vendido')
    FOR UPDATE OF f
  ), suspended AS (
    UPDATE public.crm_follow_ups f
      SET status='canceled',resolved_at=now(),resolution_reason='tintim_purchase_signal'
    FROM flagged x WHERE f.id=x.id
    RETURNING f.conversation_id
  ), recorded AS (
    INSERT INTO public.crm_events(conversation_id,event_type,event_origin,summary)
    SELECT s.conversation_id,'followup_held_purchase_signal','tintim',
      'Sinal externo de compra; venda nao foi confirmada no financeiro'
    FROM suspended s
    RETURNING id
  ) SELECT count(*)::integer INTO v_canceled FROM recorded;
  RETURN v_canceled;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_list_opportunities()
 RETURNS TABLE(conversation_id uuid, customer_name text, phone_e164 text, consent_status text, commercial_opt_out boolean, interest_label text, status text, source_label text, last_inbound_at timestamp with time zone, last_outbound_at timestamp with time zone, follow_up_id uuid, follow_up_due_at timestamp with time zone, follow_up_status text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.crm_require_staff();
 RETURN QUERY SELECT c.id,cu.display_name,cu.phone_e164,cu.consent_status,
   cu.commercial_opt_out,c.interest_label,c.status,c.source_label,
   c.last_inbound_at,c.last_outbound_at,
   f.id,f.due_at,f.status,c.created_at
 FROM public.crm_conversations c
 JOIN public.crm_customers cu ON cu.id=c.customer_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT fu.id,fu.due_at,fu.status FROM public.crm_follow_ups fu
   WHERE fu.conversation_id=c.id ORDER BY fu.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
 ) f ON true
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN f.status='pending' AND f.due_at<=now() THEN 0
               WHEN f.status='pending' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
          coalesce(f.due_at,c.updated_at) DESC
 LIMIT 150;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_list_tintim_candidates(p_limit integer DEFAULT 40)
 RETURNS TABLE(tintim_id uuid, contact_name text, phone_hint text, stage_label text, source_label text, campaign_name text, last_seen_at timestamp with time zone, imported boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.crm_require_staff();
  RETURN QUERY SELECT t.id,
   coalesce(nullif(trim(t.contact_name),''),'Contato WhatsApp'),
   right(t.phone_digits,4),t.stage_label,t.source_label,t.campaign_name,
   t.last_observed_at, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.crm_conversations cc WHERE cc.tintim_conversation_id=t.id)
  FROM public.tintim_conversations t
  WHERE t.phone_digits IS NOT NULL AND t.phone_digits ~ '^(55)?[1-9][0-9]{9,10}$'
  ORDER BY t.last_observed_at DESC LIMIT least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,40),1),100);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_list_tintim_product_hints()
 RETURNS TABLE(conversation_id uuid, product_id text, basis text, last_seen_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.crm_require_staff();
 RETURN QUERY SELECT h.conversation_id,h.product_id,h.basis,h.last_seen_at
 FROM public.crm_tintim_product_hints h
 JOIN public.crm_conversations c ON c.id=h.conversation_id
 WHERE c.status NOT IN ('closed','lost','converted')
 ORDER BY h.last_seen_at DESC LIMIT 200;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_list_tintim_signals()
 RETURNS TABLE(conversation_id uuid, stage_label text, ad_name text, campaign_name text, last_observed_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.crm_require_staff();
  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT c.id,t.stage_label,t.ad_name,t.campaign_name,t.last_observed_at
    FROM public.crm_conversations c
    JOIN public.tintim_conversations t ON t.id=c.tintim_conversation_id
    ORDER BY t.last_observed_at DESC
    LIMIT 150;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_protect_purchase_signal_followup()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status='pending' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.crm_conversations c
    JOIN public.tintim_conversations t ON t.id=c.tintim_conversation_id
    WHERE c.id=NEW.conversation_id
      AND lower(btrim(coalesce(t.stage_label,''))) IN
         ('comprou','convertido','venda realizada','vendido')
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'crm_possible_purchase_review_required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_record_tintim_message_diagnostic(p_reason text, p_field_flags text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'crm_provider_only' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_reason NOT IN ('parsed','direction_missing','phone_missing',
    'timestamp_missing','timestamp_outside_window','invalid_payload','other')
    OR p_field_flags !~ '^[01]{16}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'crm_invalid_diagnostic' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.crm_tintim_message_diagnostics(reason,field_flags)
  VALUES(p_reason,p_field_flags)
  ON CONFLICT(reason,field_flags) DO UPDATE SET
    count_events=public.crm_tintim_message_diagnostics.count_events+1,
    last_seen_at=now();
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_record_tintim_product_mention(p_fingerprint text, p_product_id text, p_action text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_event record;v_done integer;
BEGIN
 IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'crm_provider_only' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 IF p_fingerprint !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR p_action NOT IN ('set','clear')
    OR p_product_id NOT IN (
      'fatia-chocolate-morango','fatia-ninho-morango','fatia-prestigio',
      'fatia-chocolate-maracuja','fatia-chocolatudo',
      'fatia-coco-cremoso-morango','fatia-chocolate-cenoura')
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',false,'reason','invalid_input'); END IF;

 -- O próprio evento must have passed the existing authenticated + deduped webhook,
 -- must be inbound and linked to an actual CRM conversation (observation-only denied).
 SELECT e.id,e.conversation_id,e.occurred_at INTO v_event
 FROM public.crm_tintim_message_events e
 WHERE e.fingerprint=p_fingerprint AND e.direction='inbound'
   AND e.conversation_id IS NOT NULL
   AND e.occurred_at BETWEEN now()-interval '24 hours' AND now()+interval '1 minute';
 IF NOT FOUND THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',false,'reason','unverified_message');
 END IF;

 -- Não alterar interesse confirmado pela equipe nem estado do atendimento.
 IF p_action='clear' THEN
   DELETE FROM public.crm_tintim_product_hints h
   WHERE h.conversation_id=v_event.conversation_id
     AND h.product_id=p_product_id
     AND h.last_seen_at <= v_event.occurred_at;
   GET DIAGNOSTICS v_done=ROW_COUNT;
 ELSE
   INSERT INTO public.crm_tintim_product_hints(
     conversation_id,product_id,message_event_id,last_seen_at
   ) VALUES(v_event.conversation_id,p_product_id,v_event.id,v_event.occurred_at)
   ON CONFLICT(conversation_id) DO UPDATE
     SET product_id=excluded.product_id,
         message_event_id=excluded.message_event_id,
         last_seen_at=excluded.last_seen_at,updated_at=now()
     WHERE public.crm_tintim_product_hints.last_seen_at<=excluded.last_seen_at;
   GET DIAGNOSTICS v_done=ROW_COUNT;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',true,'changed',v_done>0);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_tintim_message_diagnostic_summary()
 RETURNS TABLE(reason text, field_flags text, events bigint, last_seen_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.crm_require_staff();
  RETURN QUERY SELECT d.reason,d.field_flags,d.count_events,d.last_seen_at
    FROM public.crm_tintim_message_diagnostics d
    ORDER BY d.count_events DESC,d.last_seen_at DESC LIMIT 30;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_tintim_message_diagnostics()
 RETURNS TABLE(direction text, events bigint, latest timestamp with time zone, apply_to_followups boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.crm_require_staff();
 RETURN QUERY SELECT e.direction,count(*)::bigint,max(e.occurred_at),
   (SELECT s.apply_to_followups FROM public.crm_tintim_observation_settings s WHERE s.singleton=true)
 FROM public.crm_tintim_message_events e GROUP BY e.direction;
END; $function$
